notes.title: Progress Update
notes.content:
Hello! 

A progress update about what I have been working on this year so far!

Chapter 3 is all done, I have almost finished polishing off chapter 4 and will be onto chapter 5 this month! (out of the 8 chapters Allogloom has.) 

Polish has involved tweaking some of the puzzles by fleshing them out, adding some more “oomph” to some of the scenes to make them more visually interesting. Fixing some of the animations that were a bit too janky. Also resizing assets, fixing typos, all that fun stuff!

I have also planned out the new intro to the game which will help to set the scene and introduce Gruesome Grove properly. I have started working on this alongside finishing off the rest of the chapters. 

Here’s a sneak peak of a few things I have been working on:

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44762026/1beab95d56d63c363e497cfd15e35b56a09271fe.jpg

Will keep you updated as I make more progress!

- Galactic Ghosty 👻

notes.title: End Of Year Progress Update!
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

It’s been an awesome 2024 for Allogloom, from conferences/festivals to winning awards and releasing the demo! 

Thank you again to everyone who has played the demo. Your feedback is invaluable! 💚

So what’s next?

I am working my butt off to polish, bug fix and tweak the rest of the chapters of the game as needed.
Playtesting! This is ongoing for the rest of the chapters.
Kim (musician) is also polishing and finishing off some of the later chapters' music tracks.
I'm also working on a proper story introduction for the game. Which will help to introduce Gruesome Grove, Nora and her family and the strange goings on in the village.

I will keep you updated as I make progress and I hope you all have a lovely holiday season.

- Galactic Ghosty 👻

notes.title: Some Small Updates To The Demo.
notes.content:
Audio 

 Turned down some loud SFX.
 Turned down the music.
 Added ambient background sounds to scenes.
 There is now a longer pause between the background song while playing to stop it from sounding too repetitive.

UI 

 Arrows have been added to the zoom in/look at scenes so it's easier to see where to exit them.
 Can now press spacebar to skip through dialogue.
 Can now press E to open and close the inventory.
 There is now sound on the music volume buttons to show it’s going up or down.
 Added a loading screen to the game startup.

Puzzles

 A particular dialogue puzzle now has a few more hints to nudge you in the right way to solve it.

Graphics

 Dad and Tommy’s shiny ears are now less shiny.

notes.title: Allogloom Won Awards! 🏆🏆🏆
notes.content:
Allogloom was lucky enough to be nominated for 3 awards in the NZ Game Awards! Annnd won all 3!


 The ‘Slice of Heaven’ Grand Prize
 The Decorative Piece: Excellence in Visual Art
 The Poetic Serving: Excellence in Narrative


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44762026/b82164b3e2639157b318b2ab411bd4b438481702.jpg

It was so cool to be a part of the Pavs and to see other awesome games being made in NZ and Aussie.

To receive awards for my very first game has blown my mind, and I am beyond grateful!

Thanks to the NZ Games Festival for putting together such an amazing event!

- Galactic Ghosty 👻

notes.title: Allogloom Update!
notes.content:
Hello Everyone! 

Some updates, I’ll start with the exciting stuff!

Demo

I am working on having a demo up soon for you all to play and give feedback on! I’m just doing the last bits of playtesting to get some final stuff tweaked before it comes out.

New Steam Page Look

The art needed a bit of a refresh to better represent Allogloom. So new screenshots, shiny new capsule art and the “about this game” section have all been updated.

Playtesting

Up to chapter 3 has now been playtested and I'm working on making all the changes from the feedback I’ve received. So fixing any bugs found, improving graphics where needed, narrative improvements and overall quality polish!

Youtube

I have uploaded a Q&A video on Youtube for some lovely commenters who had questions for me! So if that interests you head over to Galactic Ghosty on Youtube.

[previewyoutube=NKsmky18h3E;full][/previewyoutube]

Showcase

Allogloom was lucky enough to be accepted into the Wireframe showcase! I had an absolutely wonderful time and it was really fun being able to chat with all who attended and played the demo! (Thanks for finding some funny little bugs for me too)
